column1: # Screen table for side-by-side.sh (FR-L37, #222). Tab separated, one row per client screen.
# Columns: name, app route (EMBER_CR_ROUTE), extra app env (space separated), mockup page with
# its hash, mockup localStorage (key=value pairs joined by ';'), mockup action (JavaScript run
# after load). A lone '-' means none. A '-' in the mockup page column means the mockup has no
# state with a deterministic entry for that screen: the app is captured alone and no pair is made.
